issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition.select.column.type: column.type is a FHIR StructureDefinition URI; implementations should report an error if the returned type does not match the declared type.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe: Patient column path "'abc'" with type "integer" generated SQL with a runtime guard but DuckDB execution returned [(None,)] instead of reporting a ViewDefinition column type mismatch. The gap affects non-simple primitive FHIRPath expressions because the complex-result guard only fires for JSON object/array values.
issues.root_cause: Non-simple ViewDefinition column expressions only used the complex JSON guard; primitive runtime type names reported by FHIRPath were not compared with declared primitive column.type.
issues.resolution: SQLGenerator now treats reported non-simple primitive type names as type evidence for declared primitive columns, with temporal String transport compatibility for official boundary functions.
